channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: Spritely: Infrastructure for the Future of the Internet
item.description: Christine Lemmer-Webber and David Thompson explain how Spritely's architecture solves core decentralization challenges. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Vercel Labs Ships scriptc, a TypeScript-to-Native Compiler That Leaves the JavaScript Engine Behind
item.description: Vercel Labs has introduced scriptc, an experimental compiler that converts TypeScript into small native executables without relying on Node, V8, or a JavaScript engine. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: The Periodic Table of HTML Elements
item.description: All 115 elements of the current HTML specification laid out as a periodic table: search, filters by spec section and links to MDN. (2 sources: frontendfocus, nodeweekly)

item.title: Apple Copland D11E4 Emulator in Your Browser
item.description: Apple’s ill-fated Copland operating system is notoriously hard to run on real hardware, and has not previously been available in emulation. Here is the last build, D11E4 from June 1996, in an improved DingusPPC. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Chrome 155 beta adds support
item.description: Get a preview of the next Chrome release with this post detailing the features in the current beta. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: The Root Scroller and How Not to Lose It
item.description: Every page has one main scroll container that scrolls the page itself: the root scroll container, or root scroller for short. Because it scrolls the entire page… (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: "AI, Make the Website Good"
item.description: A post by Zach Leatherman (zachleat) (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: The Era of Agentic Mobile Development Is Built on Expo
item.description: Expo is the fastest way to build native apps for iOS, Android, and the web with React. (1 source: frontendfocus)
